name: section_heading
label: Heading
help_text: Optional - leave empty to hide. Same fixed treatment as the Table module's own heading: normal text is fixed Blue, Arial Regular; wrap text in Bold to render it Purple, Arial Black - regardless of any other setting. No separate color/typography choice exists for this field.

name: section_paragraph
label: Paragraph
help_text: Optional - leave empty to hide. Renders using the theme's global typography.
default: Body copy slot. Each row: date, type, time, location, title, description, CTA — all repeatable fields.

name: events
label: Events
help_text: Each event is fully editable. The editor can add, remove, and reorder events.

children.name: disabled
children.label: Disabled
children.help_text: Applies the past-event/disabled visual state to this entire event (badge, meta line, title, description, and CTA) without removing it from the layout or hiding its content. Off by default.

children.name: event_day
children.label: Day
children.help_text: Short day number shown in the date badge, e.g. "24".

children.name: event_month
children.label: Month
children.help_text: Short month abbreviation shown in the date badge, e.g. "SEP".

children.name: meta_line
children.label: Meta line
children.help_text: Free text - the line above the title, e.g. "Webinar · 12:00 ET · Online" or "Past Event · On Demand".

children.name: title
children.label: Title
children.help_text: Renders as Heading 5, in Arial Black. Fixed Black text color - not tied to a module-level color choice.
children.default: The Pre-Audit Self-Check, Live: 10 Settings in 45 Minutes

children.name: description
children.label: Description
children.help_text: Renders using the theme's global typography.
children.default: Walk the checklist on a demo tenant with a CxMSB specialist.

children.name: link_type
children.label: CTA type
children.help_text: Choose whether this event's CTA links to a HubSpot CTA or a regular link. Leave the text/link below empty to omit the CTA entirely.

children.name: text
children.label: CTA text
children.help_text: Only used for the Regular link type - a HubSpot CTA carries its own text. Leave empty to omit the CTA. Not automatically changed by Disabled above - update it yourself (e.g. to "Watch") for a past event.

children.name: variant
children.label: CTA style
children.help_text: Applies to both a regular link and a HubSpot CTA. When Disabled above is on, this event's CTA always renders in the muted disabled style shown in the reference screenshot regardless of this choice.

default.title: The Pre-Audit Self-Check, Live: 10 Settings in 45 Minutes
default.description: Walk the checklist on a demo tenant with a CxMSB specialist.

default.title: Copilot Readiness Workshop: From Licensed to Loaded
default.description: Data, permissions and adoption planning for teams rolling out this fiscal year.

default.title: Compliance Mapping for Provincial Privacy Rules
default.description: Past-event state — row dims and the CTA switches to Watch.

children.name: spacing_desktop
children.label: Desktop spacing
children.help_text: Top/bottom padding on desktop. Left/right are hidden - horizontal spacing comes from .content-wrapper.

children.name: spacing_mobile
children.label: Mobile spacing
children.help_text: Top/bottom padding at the theme's mobile breakpoint (max-width: 767px), independent of the desktop value above.
